description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to amend the Schedule to the Order Published in Gaz.Ex.Ord No. 1469/38 of 03.11.2006 which Specifies the Faculties & Departments of the University of Moratuwa by adding the item "13. Department of Languages"
reasoning: This gazette content involves the amendment of a university's organizational structure through a legal order issued under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It constitutes a regulatory action (adding a new department) performed through statutory authority, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the regulatory function being performed.
